comments.body_html: Hi. Did I get it right that if I set the parameters with GlobalMultiplier: 1.0 — Chest: 80 Head: 35 Stomach: 70 LeftLeg/Right: 65 LeftArm/Right: 60 — then all bosses and other NPCs will have the same HP as the player?

comments.author: waldfee
comments.body_html: BodyPartMultipliers are multipliers too and are exclusive with GlobalMultiplier - you can only use one or the other. If you set GlobalMultiplier to 1.0 and BodyPartMultipliers to null, all bosses will have the same HP as the player, yes.
